plan: Given my private value of $49, I should aim to bid just below my full value to maximize profit while ensuring a win. Assuming rational opponents, they are unlikely to bid more than their value, which is at most $49. A bid slightly below $49, like $48.9, should secure a win unless they bid their max value, which is unlikely. This strategy maximizes profit by winning with a high chance while minimizing the payment.

With a value of $44, I aim to win while minimizing cost. Bidding slightly below my value can secure the prize without overpaying. To maximize profit, I will bid $40, anticipating opponents value lower or similar, ensuring a win unless they bid aggressively.

Given my value of $22, I aim to win by bidding slightly below my value to maximize profit. I will bid $20, ensuring I pay less if I win. This strategy balances winning chances and profit maximization, considering others may bid close to their values. Since this is the only round, I focus on immediate profit, not long-term strategy.
